title: Wild Bill Donovan parachutes in with a butterfly collection for Ho Chi Minh

tellings.quote: by the way because John Donovan delivered a very rare butterfly collection to him at parach shooting in with a taped to his chest

plain: Bill Donovan, the American wartime spy chief known as Wild Bill, is said to have parachuted into Vietnam with a very rare butterfly collection taped to his chest, as a gift for the Vietnamese leader Ho Chi Minh. Joe McMoneagle, who worked as a psychic spy for the US Army, tells Michels this as a story passed on to him by someone else. If true, it would show a strangely personal tie between American intelligence and Ho Chi Minh.
